senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; preced. wds.) purity, righteousness, equity, liberality, esp. almsgiving.
units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 5:7">Deut. R. s. 5</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 21:3">Prov. XXI, 3</cite>) <he>הקרבנות … והצ׳ והדין מכפרין וכ׳</he> sacrifices effect atonement only for the involuntary sinner, but righteousness (or charity) and justice atone for &c.
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 3:17">Tosef. Dem. III, 17</cite>, v. <cite ref="C00084"><he>גַּבָּיי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 118b:8">Sabb. 118ᵇ</cite> <he>גבאי צ׳</he> collectors of public charity; <he>מחלקי צ׳</he> distributors of charity, v. <cite ref="H01114"><he>חֵלֶק</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sukkah 49b:12">Succ. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>גדולה ג״ח יותר מן הצ׳</he> deeds of love are worth more than almsgiving; <cite ref="Sukkah 49b:11">ib.</cite> <he>צ׳ בממונו ג״ח וכ׳</he> charity is done at the mere sacrifice of money, deeds of love are performed with one’s money and with one’s person; <he>צ׳ לעניים ג״ח וכ׳</he> almsgiving is only for the poor, deeds of love for the poor and the rich.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 10b:12">B. Bath. 10ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 14:34">Prov. XIV, 34</cite>) <he>כשם … צ׳ מכפרת וכ׳</he> as the sin-offering brings atonement for Israel, so charity is a means of atonement for the nations.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49:4">Gen. R. s. 49</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 18:19">Gen. XVIII, 19</cite>) <he>מתחלה צ׳ ולבסוף משפט</he> (not <he>צדק</he>) first charity (undiscriminating hospitality), and then justice; a. fr.—Pl. <he>צְרָקוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 10a:16">B. Bath. 10ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 11:4">Prov. XI, 4</cite>, a.

<cite ref="Proverbs 10:2">X, 2</cite>) <he>שתי צ׳ הללו למה</he> why two verses saying the same thing about charity? <cite ref="Tractate Derekh Eretz Rabbah 2:27">Treat. Der. Er. ch. II</cite> <he>מחלקי צ׳</he>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 5:12">Ruth R. to III, 3</cite> <he>וסכת זו מצוות וצ׳</he> ‘anoint thyself’ (<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 5:12">ib.</cite>), that means with good deeds and charitable acts; a. e.
